raw_html: [[Thunderclap]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Thunderclap]]:''' This potent ability will in certain cases send forth a cacophony of sound. On an attack roll of 20, which is confirmed as a critical hit, the target may suffer the following conditions: [[Stunned]], [[Knockdown]], and [[Disoriented|Disorient]].
